name: save-boot-29c-battle-item-cursor
description: #253 attempt 1, H4 (Item list cursor). Boot point "lists-battle" (save-boot-29): Cloud alone (HP 200/600, MP 300/300; author-chosen), materia 53 (AP 40000) in weapon slot 0 and 49 (AP 0) in slot 1, inventory slots 0-6 = item 1 x3, item 3 x2, item 0 x5, item 0 x9 x4. A press is 4 frames, then a wait of up to 30 frames for the expected read, then 8 frames. A wait metric is frames waited, 0 on a timeout (which stops the script). Only frame counts, 1/0 and small menu values leave. First menu: Down, Down to command row 3 (Item; Summon has no command and is skipped, #171), Circle, wait until the widget leaves 1 (iw_wait), 30 frames. The item cursor row and scroll must read 0. Down: row 1 (i_d1). Down: row 2 (i_d2). Down: the scroll leaves 0 (i_s1). End values: i_row, i_scroll (what one scroll step reads), widget (the Item list's widget id). match: a rerun.

widget.description: g_BattleMenuModalWidgetId (s16 as u16; confirmed #110 for -1, 0, 1): 1 the command menu, 0 target selection, 0xffff none. Which value a Magic or Item list reads is what #253 asks; the decomp names 7 for the Summon list (src/battle/battle3.c BattleMenuInputState7).
